statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (x y : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2), KdVPlan.FromLP s (x-y) = KdVPlan.FromLP s x-KdVPlan.FromLP s y
proof:
intro s x y
funext k
change (KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k : ℂ)*(x k-y k) =
  (KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k : ℂ)*x k-(KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k : ℂ)*y k
ring
